description:
List team entries that name a BTC address as a teammate and still need its confirmation. Defaults to the current wallet's BTC address.

Each invite has bountyId, bountyTitle, rewardSats, expiresAt, submissionId, leadBtcAddress, teamSize and shareSats. Only invites that can still be confirmed are listed (bounties the address already entered are left out). Accept with bounty_team_confirm, decline with bounty_team_remove.

No authentication required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

btc_address.description: BTC address to query. Omit to use the current wallet's BTC address.

name: bounty_pending_invites
